config.tacz.client.key.auto_reload.desc: Try to reload automatically when the gun is empty
config.tacz.client.key.hold_to_aim.desc: True if you want to hold the right mouse button to aim
config.tacz.client.key.hold_to_crawl.des: True if you want to hold the crawl button to crawl
config.tacz.client.render.auto_select_gu: Auto Filter Gun Smith Table By Held Item
When opening a gun smith table with a gun, attachment, or ammo in your main hand, automatically select the held item filter.
config.tacz.client.render.bullet_hole_pa: The threshold for fading out when rendering bullet hole particles
The existence time of bullet hole particles, in tick
config.tacz.client.render.crosshair_type: The crosshair when holding a gun
config.tacz.client.render.damage_counter: Damage counter reset time of target minecart, in millisecond
config.tacz.client.render.disable_intera: Disable the interact hud text in center of the screen
config.tacz.client.render.disable_moveme: Disable all fov effect from the movement speed attribute while holding a gun.
config.tacz.client.render.enable_tooltip: Display the gun/ammo/attachment id in item tooltip when advanced tooltip(F3+H) is on.
config.tacz.client.render.enable_translu: Should enable translucent while rendering block entity like gunsmith table or statue. Enable this option will result in ADDITIONAL PERFORMANCE OVERHEAD.
config.tacz.client.render.first_person_b: Whether or not to render first person bullet trail
config.tacz.client.render.gun_hud_enable: Whether or not to display the gun's HUD
config.tacz.client.render.gun_lod_render: How far to display the lod model, 0 means always display
config.tacz.client.render.head_shot_debu: Whether or not to display the head shot's hitbox
config.tacz.client.render.hit_market_sta: The starting position of the hit marker when kill
config.tacz.client.render.kill_amount_du: The duration of the kill amount, in second
config.tacz.client.render.kill_amount_en: Whether or not to display the kill amount
Whether or not apply fadeout effect on the laser beam. Close this may improve laser performance under some shaders.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_mask_ena: Clip the scope body and reticle to the ocular while aiming, making the scope see-through.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_debu: Diagnostic only: still capture, but do not composite. If the magnified image still overflows, the leak is in the capture/offscreen path.
Diagnostic only: paints the PIP composite coverage solid magenta. Whole screen = composite leaking; lens only = composite is correct.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_enab: Use a real magnified picture inside the scope lens while the world outside stays 1x. Default off; high zoom lenses are visibly softer.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_min_: Aim progress below which PIP is skipped; the aperture is nearly closed anyway.
Scopes below this magnification keep the classic whole-screen zoom; PIP costs too much softness below this point.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_shar: Unsharp-mask strength for the magnified lens. Weighted by zoom: 0 at 1x, full at 6x and above.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_worl: How much of the scope zoom is applied to the world. 0 = pure PIP (world always 1x, softest lens). 1 = old whole-screen zoom (sharpest, equals disabling PIP).
config.tacz.client.render.target_render_: The farthest render distance of the target, including minecarts type
config.tacz.client.resource.enable_lazy_: Build heavy client assets such as models and animation state machines on demand. Inventory items are pre-warmed in the background when possible.
config.tacz.client.sound.default_sound_c: Max active normal gun sounds for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.tacz.client.sound.first_person_an: Use a non-relative entity-tracking world sound source for first-person animation keyframe sounds. This can improve compatibility with physical sound mods, but may introduce slight stereo drift while moving.
config.tacz.client.sound.high_frequency_: Max active high-frequency gun sounds, such as shooting and animation keyframe sounds, for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.tacz.client.sound.hit_sound_concu: Max active hit feedback sounds for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.tacz.client.zoom.screen_distance_: Screen distance coefficient for zoom, using MDV standard, default is MDV133
config.tacz.client.zoom.zoom_sensitivity: Zoom sensitivity is multiplied by this factor
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_allo: Whether to run Picture-in-Picture optics when an Iris shader pack is active.
